title: Multilingual and Explainable Text Detoxification with Parallel Corpora

bias_targets.methodology: Evaluating text detoxification approaches (including unsupervised baselines, supervised models like mBART, and LLM-based Chain-of-Thought) using Style Transfer Accuracy (STA), Content Similarity (SIM), and Fluency (ChrF1) metrics on multilingual parallel corpora.

Using GPT-4 to extract descriptive features and perform K-means clustering on text encodings to identify and detoxify condescending, derogatory, and stereotypically biased language (specifically grouped as 'Cluster 1').

Conducting cross-lingual toxic keyword analysis to identify homophobic insults and derogatory comparisons (particularly prevalent in the Ukrainian, Russian, and Chinese datasets) and evaluating the models' ability to rephrase them.

Analyzing culturally specific expressions of toxicity, specifically hate speech and derogatory wordplay targeting temporarily displaced individuals and asylum seekers in the German dataset, to guide localized detoxification strategies.
